test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If in each of the following words, each letter is replaced by its next letter in the English alphabetical order, then how many words thus formed will not have any vowels?

1) TOGETHER

2) BOXES

3) SPORTS

4) DRINK
solution:
According to the given information:

Each letter is replaced by its next letter in the English alphabetical order:

1) TOGETHER

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf2d835cdebab82847a27af8ff54879b7a89d1635f3abc4422a7928795c1f00d.png] 

2) BOXES

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4c01dbe779e9f9c81d9249946c273a4b7bff1969152d2516cf89f411576623e.png] 

3) SPORTS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52cfac8de7776ab3f97923170bfa5a324a9fe6f1fadefcf4dff57ec9f3ffc012.png] 

4) DRINK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fdbacfdc46beb7d3cc9bac323dd632221b09d058b2e6793ef60277e550feec6.png] 

Then **One **(BOXES) words thus formed will not have any vowels.

Hence, the correct answer is "**One**".
